title: ci(automerge): tighten trust gates and disable direct merge fallback
summary: Auto-merge requires explicit opt-in and avoids privileged direct fallback merging.
details: Use pull_request events, require the automerge label, remove direct merge fallback and reduce contents permission to read.
Original GitHub merge 10b534a32d71434d3fafe5c03ad87ea7c225441a is distinct from rewritten main-history delivery 291a08c11d7e130c793ebe3d856e3dc63cd24a7d; the merge date is the verified GitHub date.
